subject: general
question:
Study the given pattern carefully and select the number that can replace the question mark(?) in it.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7f62743ef563e6cca8dad4c496b1ee024dc5bd807b2cded9b7888b741f98d514.png]
solution:
The logic followed here is:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3fd5993325c9d37629c204b1b6538dc379c34f89ed303cab8ab6029e94737deb.png] 

⇒ (6 + 3 + 18) ÷ 3 = 9

⇒ (27 ÷ 3) = 9

⇒ 9 = 9 (LHS = RHS)

And,

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/96671d4c0535942e37e9e6ac9be5966c23fe68f0e3238fc523113d110d2e81b9.png] 

⇒ (3 + 4 + 17) ÷ 3 = 8

⇒ (24 ÷ 3) = 8

⇒ 8 = 8 (LHS = RHS)

Similarly,

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/1c00864389a91da818cefbe08952d5dff114553daa8b6c6f328d24f9059faa1a.png] 

⇒ (5 + 13 + 15) ÷ 3 = ?

⇒ (33 ÷ 3) = ?

⇒ **11 = ?**

Hence, "Option 3" is the correct answer.
